name: pet-snippets-local
title: Pet Snippets
description: Search and use local pet snippets in Raycast and Vicinae.
author: deyunluo

commands.name: index
commands.title: Search Pet Snippets
commands.description: Search, copy, and paste local pet snippets.

preferences.name: petConfigPath
preferences.title: Pet Config File Path
preferences.description: Used only in Pet CLI mode

preferences.name: petBinaryPath
preferences.title: Pet Binary Path
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to pet binary (useful when GUI PATH is limited)

preferences.name: snippetFilePath
preferences.title: Pet Snippet File Path
preferences.description: Used only in Snippet File mode

preferences.name: defaultAction
preferences.title: Default Action
preferences.description: Set the first action shown for each snippet

preferences.name: commandDisplay
preferences.title: Command Display
preferences.description: Choose how command text is shown in list results

preferences.name: lastUsedDisplay
preferences.title: Last Used Display
preferences.description: Show or hide usage time in list accessories
